document.abstract: Over the past two years, generative AI has moved from buzzword to Wall Street play to ubiquitous presence across creative workflows. Industry surveys show that adoption of generative AI has skyrocketed-one 2024 report from the State of Digital Publishing 1 found roughly 80% of media professionals were using generative AI tools, with deeper integration into daily tasks than ever before. OpenAI reports that ChatGPT has been used by over 10% of adults worldwide, with half of the users falling between the ages of 18 and 25.
